result.note: Tests the body that launched FAST-DS, its Budget origin and the declaration deadline.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure Scheme (FAST-DS), launched in August 2026:
items: It was launched by the Central Board of Direct Taxes and was first announced in the Union Budget 2026-27.
Online declarations under the scheme are open until 31 March 2027.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The CBDT launched FAST-DS on 16 August 2026, and online declarations are open until 31 December 2026, not March 2027. The scheme targets students, young professionals, technology employees and relocated non-resident Indians who may have failed to disclose overseas holdings.
questions.source: launched the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure Scheme (FAST-DS), first announced in the 2026-27 Budget, on Sunday, with online declarations open until 31 December.
